https://24.kg/article/sankcii-protiv-tre.body: Великобритания 8 октября ввела санкции против трех зарегистрированных в Кыргызстане компаний. Новые ограничения опубликованы в официальном санкционном уведомлении Министерства иностранных дел страны. Читайте по теме В Кыргызстане зачистят еще около 35 компаний из-за санкционных рисков Под санкции попали ОАО «Процессинг КейДжи», ЗАО «ТокенСпот» и ОсОО «Цунами Пейментс». А также директор «Процессинг КейДжи» Улан Букабаев. Единственным акционером «Процессинг КейДжи» выступает Министерство финансов Кыргызстана. Четыре записи внесли в санкционный список в рамках британского режима ограничений в отношении России. ОАО «Процессинг КейДжи» присвоен идентификатор RUS3756. Компании: замораживают активы; ограничивают предоставление трастовых услуг; ограничивают действия, связанные с директорами; ограничивают интернет-сервисы; запрещают британским кредитным и финансовым организациям корреспондентские банковские отношения; запрещают обработку платежей в пользу, от имени или через компанию. В санкционной карточке британская сторона указывает Минфин КР как материнскую структуру компании. Британские власти объяснили решение тем, что, по их оценке, существуют разумные основания подозревать «Процессинг КейДжи» в деятельности, которая приносит выгоду правительству России или оказывает ему поддержку посредством ведения бизнеса, имеющего экономическое значение для российского государства. В карточке ОАО «Процессинг КейДжи» британские власти указали два сайта компании: processing-kg.com; vexpay.net. Таким образом, британский санкционный список напрямую связывает платежную платформу VexPay с «Процессинг КейДжи». Под персональные санкции попал директор ОАО «Процессинг КейДжи» Улан Арымбаевич Букабаев. В его отношении Великобритания ввела: заморозку активов; запрет на въезд; ограничения на трастовые услуги; ограничения на занятие директорских должностей в британской юрисдикции. Основанием британская сторона назвала его работу директором «Процессинг КейДжи». Читайте по теме Минимизация санкционных рисков: прекращена деятельность 16 компаний В тот же список Великобритания включила зарегистрированное в Бишкеке ЗАО «ТокенСпот» — идентификатор RUS3758. Компания получила тот же основной набор финансовых ограничений. Британское правительство заявило о наличии разумных оснований подозревать TokenSpot в получении выгоды от правительства России или его поддержке через деятельность в российском финансовом секторе, который Великобритания относит к стратегически значимым отраслям. Третьей кыргызстанской компанией в новом британском списке стало ОсОО «Цунами Пейментс», которому присвоили идентификатор RUS3763. Британская сторона объяснила решение предполагаемой деятельностью компании в российском финансовом секторе. «Цунами Пейментс» зарегистрировали в Кыргызстане в феврале 2024 года. В июне того же года Нацбанк выдал компании две лицензии. Одна дает право проводить процессинг и клиринг платежей и расчетов третьих лиц, другая — принимать и проводить платежи и расчеты за товары и услуги через платежные системы.

https://en.tengrihealth.kz/tengri-health.body: Қазақша Русский Выберите язык Қазақша Русский NEWS News Read Listen LIFE Beautifully Profitably Healthily Curiously Horoscopes Recipes SPORT Sports Around Sports Trends Champions League AUTO News Useful Blogs Reviews Special Projects HEALTH News Articles HOME News Articles TRAVEL My Country Around the World Travel Notes Zailiyskiy Alatau Routes Sayakhat Time EDU News Education Institutions About the project Contact us Jobs Advertise site.press_release Contact us +7 (777) 001 44 99 Advertise +7(700) 3 888 188 We are in the social. networks Kazakhstan reacts to reports of possible plague in Russia ПОДЕЛИТЬСЯ Photo:depositphotos.com Tengrinews.kz — The Ministry of Health of Kazakhstan is monitoring the situation in the Irkutsk region following the death of a 28-year-old employee of a plague research institute. Amid reports of a possible highly dangerous infection, sanitary and quarantine controls have been tightened at the border, with reference to press service of the Ministry of Health. Statement from the Ministry of Health of Kazakhstan The Ministry of Health stated that it is tracking the situation in the Irkutsk region, where 197 people were placed under medical observation following the death of a 28-year-old employee of a plague research institute. Officials also reported that the situation is under constant supervision, and the preliminary risk of the infection being imported into Kazakhstan is assessed as low . "The situation will be clarified as official information becomes available," the ministry stated. Sanitary and quarantine controls are currently being conducted at state border crossing points. According to the ministry, no passengers with elevated temperatures, symptoms of illness, or suspected highly dangerous infections have been identified so far. Kazakhstanis who notice symptoms of illness after traveling are advised to seek medical assistance as soon as possible and inform the doctor of their travel history and return date. Details surrounding the death of the 28-year-old woman On the night of October 2, 28-year-old Daria Shipilova died in the intensive care unit of the Shelekhov District Hospital. She worked at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute and was professionally involved in the study of dangerous pathogens. Russian specialists are currently investigating the circumstances of her potential infection. According to the publication "Lyudi Baikala," she may have accidentally broken a test tube containing the bacterium Yersinia pestis—the causative agent of the plague—while working with live biomaterial in the laboratory on September 25. However, there has been no official confirmation of this information . Following the incident, the woman's condition reportedly deteriorated sharply. She was hospitalized at the Shelekhov District Hospital. Initially, unaware of the potential laboratory incident, medics suspected a severe case of coronavirus infection, according to Euronews. Later, due to the rapid decline in the patient's condition, doctors conducted rapid tests for highly dangerous infections. The woman was placed on a ventilator, but she could not be saved. Cause of death of the anti-plague institute employee Residents of the Irkutsk region and other Russian regions are currently concerned by rumors of a possible outbreak of pneumonic plague. On October 4, Rospotrebnadzor reported AiF-Irkutsk that the sanitary and epidemiological situation in the Irkutsk region, Irkutsk, and Shelekhov remains stable. No cases of plague have been identified in the region. The agency stated that it the woman's cause of death was "pneumonia of unknown etiology" . Russian specialists are continuing their epidemiological investigation to determine the source and circumstances of the potential infection. Following the incident, 197 people who may have been in contact with the deceased woman were placed under medical observation. According to available data, none of them have shown symptoms of the disease, and laboratory test results have come back negative. Anti-epidemic measures are being carried out at the Shelekhov District Hospital. https://kz.kursiv.media/en/2026-10-01/en.body: Firm owned by Kazakh tycoon Mutalip builds railway in Afghanistan Published October 1, 2026 04:00 Yerlan Iskakov Senior Journalist ye.iskakov@kursiv.media Zhanbolat Mamyshev Senior Journalist of the Business News department zh.mamyshev@kursiv.media afghanistan kazakhstan railway Photo: Ministry of Trade and Integration of Kazakhstan Kazakhstani company Integra Construction KZ has completed the third section of the Khaf-Herat railway in Afghanistan, the Ministry of Trade and Integration reported. Businessman Shakhmurat Mutalip is the company’s sole ultimate owner. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Kazakhstan previously announced the signing of a contract between the Afghanistan Railway Authority and Integra Construction to resume construction of a 43-kilometer section of the railway from Rozanak station to Rabattarian station. Kazakhstan to supply rails and other goods for Afghanistan’s railroads / Photo: Ara.gov.af, photo editor: Arthur Aleskerov The section is part of the 191-kilometer Khaf-Herat railway line, which connects Iran and Afghanistan and is intended to give Afghanistan access to the port of Chabahar in Iran. Completion of the section was originally scheduled for May 2025. Kazakhstani companies also planned to supply rails and other products for future railway projects in Afghanistan. Share Link copied

https://kaktus.media/doc/554645_posolstv.body: kaktus.media Посольство США поздравило Кыргызстан с запуском первого спутника Политика 1160 7 октября 2026 21:57 Kaktus Все самое интересное в Telegram В диппредставительстве напомнили, что аппарат был запущен 1 октября с базы Космических сил США Ванденберг в Калифорнии с помощью ракеты-носителя Falcon 9 компании SpaceX. За запуском наблюдали президент Садыр Жапаров и представители Космических сил США. По теме: Спецпосланник Трампа поздравил Кыргызстан с запуском первого спутника По данным посольства, спутник будет использоваться для мониторинга природных чрезвычайных ситуаций и выявления ранних признаков засухи. "Космос приносит реальную пользу людям на Земле. Yesterday, 23:01 2 min read 2 414 views 0 comments 0 Source: U.S. Embassy in Dushanbe The United States has provided six unmanned aerial systems worth a combined $2.3mn to Tajikistan’s National Guard to support border security operations, according to the U.S. Embassy in Dushanbe. The equipment was handed over during a ceremony on October 2 attended by U.S. Chargé d’Affaires in Tajikistan Joel Erdman and First Deputy Commander of the National Guard Major General Bahriddin Azamatzoda. According to the embassy, the unmanned aerial systems will allow Tajikistan’s National Guard to conduct continuous surveillance of designated areas during counter-terrorism operations. The latest delivery forms part of broader U.S. security assistance to Tajikistan. According to the diplomatic mission, Washington has provided more than $600mn in security-related assistance to the country since 1992. Bilateral cooperation in this area has included military personnel training, equipment deliveries and infrastructure projects. Previous U.S. assistance has included military vehicles for Tajikistan’s border troops and Ministry of Defense, as well as specialized vehicles designed to detect illicit trafficking of nuclear and radioactive materials. The United States has also supplied body armor and equipment intended for operations in mountainous terrain. Infrastructure assistance has included funding for facilities used by Tajik security forces. The United States has also supported the construction or renovation of more than ten border outposts along the Tajikistan–Afghanistan border. https://daryo.uz/en/2026/10/07/tajikista.body: World Tajikistan, Iran expand visa-free regime to land crossings and third-country travel Tajikistan and Iran expanded their mutual visa-free regime to land crossings and travel through third countries, allowing citizens with valid passports to stay for up to 30 days within a 90-day period. Yesterday, 21:08 2 min read 2 494 views 0 comments 0 Source: iStock A mutual visa-free regime between Tajikistan and Iran came into full effect on October 5, expanding visa-free travel between the two countries beyond direct air routes, according to Saidjon Shafizoda, deputy head of the Information Department at Tajikistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, who spoke to Asia-Plus. Under the memorandum of understanding between the two countries, citizens of Tajikistan and Iran holding valid international passports can enter, transit through and temporarily stay in each other’s territory without obtaining a visa. Travelers are permitted to stay for up to 30 days within any 90-day period. The expanded arrangement applies to both international airports and land border crossings. Citizens can also enter either country by air from third countries without obtaining a visa, subject to the respective national legislation. The visa-free arrangement covers short-term travel and does not automatically provide citizens with the right to work or reside in the other country on a long-term basis. Employment and longer stays remain subject to requirements established under Tajik and Iranian law. Tajikistan and Iran initially introduced their mutual visa-free regime on August 10, 2024. During the first stage, the arrangement applied only to citizens traveling directly between the two capitals on the Dushanbe–Tehran and Tehran–Dushanbe air routes. Travelers entering through land border checkpoints or reaching either country through third countries were previously required to obtain visas. The expansion that took effect on October 5 removes these restrictions for eligible short-term travelers, allowing the visa-free regime to apply regardless of whether they cross by land or through international airports, within the conditions established by the agreement. The expansion follows the resumption of direct air connections between Tajikistan and Iran. Flights to Tehran and Mashhad resumed in the summer of 2025 following a prolonged suspension. The first flight on the Mashhad–Dushanbe–Mashhad route took place on July 4, 2025. Iran’s Varesh Airlines subsequently launched its first Tehran–Dushanbe flight on July 10. Four days later, on July 14, Tajikistan’s Somon Air resumed regular services on the Dushanbe–Tehran–Dushanbe route. Flights between the countries were suspended again in early 2026 due to restrictions affecting the use of Middle Eastern airspace. Following a three-month interruption, air services between Dushanbe and Tehran resumed on May 31. The visa-free arrangement now allows eligible Tajik and Iranian citizens to stay in each other’s countries for up to 30 days within a 90-day period, including when traveling through land crossings or arriving by air from third countries. # Diplomatik kelishuv # Eron # Havo qatnovlari # Xalqaro munosabatlar # tojikiston # vizasiz rejim Reporter Xadicha Abdurashidova All stories Telegram channel @daryo_eng Subscribe What do you think? https://www.azernews.az/region/265138.ht.body: Russia accuses Armenia of shifting responsibility over future of Gyumri military base 7 October 2026 16:40 (UTC+04:00) Akbar Novruz Read more Russia has accused Armenia's leadership of attempting to shift responsibility onto Moscow over the potential withdrawal of the 102nd Russian Military Base from Gyumri, as debate over the future of Russia's military presence in the country intensifies. Mikhail Kalugin, Director of the Fourth Department for CIS Countries at the Russian Foreign Ministry, made the remarks in an interview with RIA Novosti. According to Kalugin, Armenian officials are attempting to present the debate as though Moscow itself initiated discussions over the future of the Russian military presence. “Attempts to shift responsibility for the possible withdrawal of the base to Moscow are consistent with a curious feature of current Armenian political thinking. The ruling elite in Yerevan often expects the most important decisions to be made by external players,” Kalugin said. The Russian diplomat drew parallels with Armenia's increasingly complicated relationships with both the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) and the Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO). Kalugin argued that Yerevan has similarly sought to place responsibility for major strategic choices elsewhere, pointing to Armenian statements that a referendum concerning the country's European integration should follow a positive signal from Brussels. He also cited discussions surrounding the CSTO, saying suggestions that Armenia could simply be excluded from the Russian-led security alliance would remove the need for Yerevan itself to decide whether to formally leave. Despite the increasingly sharp rhetoric, Kalugin said Moscow remained prepared to discuss all issues surrounding the Gyumri base. Any negotiations, he stressed, would have to proceed within the framework of the existing interstate agreements governing the deployment of Russian forces in Armenia. The future of the 102nd Military Base has emerged as another point of friction between Moscow and Yerevan amid a broader deterioration in bilateral relations. Russian President Vladimir Putin said in September that Moscow would not impose its military presence on Armenia and was prepared to withdraw its forces if Yerevan concluded that the base was no longer necessary. Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan subsequently insisted that his government had never raised the question of removing the Russian base. “Since 2018, I have been in contact with the President of the Russian Federation and other senior officials, and I have never, not even once, raised the issue of withdrawing Russia’s 102nd Military Base from Armenia,” Pashinyan told parliament in September. He nevertheless said Armenia would not object if Moscow itself decided to withdraw the forces, arguing that developments in recent years had demonstrated that the Russian base was no longer of “vital importance” to Armenia's security. Pashinyan has maintained that if Russia wants to retain the base, Yerevan remains prepared to discuss the matter. The competing statements have therefore produced a dispute over who placed the future of the base on the political agenda, with Moscow accusing Yerevan of seeking to make Russia responsible for any eventual withdrawal and the Armenian government insisting that the issue was first publicly raised by the Russian side. The 102nd Russian Military Base has been stationed in Gyumri under an interstate agreement signed in 1995. An amendment agreed in 2010 extended the deployment until 2044. https://www.trend.az/casia/turkmenistan/.body: Home Central Asia Turkmenistan Turkmenistan, Iran discuss expanding transport and trade cooperation Turkmenistan News 8 October 2026 11:30 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Mejlis (Parliament) of Turkmenistan Fuad Namazov Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 8. Turkmenistan and Iran discussed strengthening transport, trade and economic cooperation during a meeting between the Chairperson of the Mejlis of Turkmenistan, Dunyagozel Gulmanova and Iran’s Minister of Roads and Urban Development, Farzaneh Sadegh, in Awaza yesterday. This was reflected in a press release published by the Mejlis (Parliament) of Turkmenistan. Gulmanova also thanked Sadegh for her participation in international events held in Turkmenistan’s Awaza National Tourist Zone. The two sides also discussed cooperation between the inter-parliamentary friendship groups, relevant parliamentary committees, young parliamentarians and women parliamentarians. During the commission's latest meeting in Tehran in 2025, the sides also discussed the creation of cross-border trade and economic zones to stimulate bilateral commerce. Energy remains a cornerstone of the relationship. In recent years, Ashgabat and Tehran have expanded cooperation on natural gas supplies, including swap arrangements and discussions on direct exports and transit through Iran to third-country markets. The two sides have also advanced cooperation in electricity transmission and maritime transport, while recent high-level meetings resulted in agreements covering natural gas, customs cooperation, port partnerships between Turkmenbashi and Amirabad, and intergovernmental cooperation plans. Transport and logistics have become another major pillar of bilateral ties as both countries seek to strengthen regional connectivity. Turkmenistan and Iran have been working to increase cargo flows across their shared border, improve road, rail, and port links, and enhance multimodal transport routes connecting Central Asia with the Persian Gulf and broader international markets. https://daryo.uz/en/2026/10/07/kazakhsta.body: World Kazakhstan seeks return of citizens recruited by Russia to fight in Ukraine Kazakhstan is negotiating with Russia to return citizens who say they were recruited for the war in Ukraine after traveling to Russia for work, as authorities verify individual cases and prepare a list for the Russian side. Yesterday, 22:01 3 min read 7 593 views 0 comments 0 Source: Screenshot from a video Kazakhstan is negotiating with Russia over the return of Kazakhstani citizens who say they were recruited to fight in the war against Ukraine after initially traveling to Russia for employment, according to Kazakhstan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Tengrinews informs. The citizens issued a video appeal requesting assistance with their return to Kazakhstan. The Foreign Ministry said it was taking measures concerning those who appeared in the appeal and continued to receive inquiries through its hotline. “Inquiries continue to be received via the hotline. Information regarding each case is being verified. Once the verification process is complete, the compiled list will be sent to the Russian side,” the ministry said. Kazakh authorities said cooperation with Russia over the cases was taking place at several levels. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Zhanbolat Ussenov said protecting the rights and interests of Kazakhstani citizens abroad remained a priority for the ministry. “The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is treating this issue with the utmost seriousness. Protecting the rights, freedoms, and legitimate interests of Kazakhstani citizens abroad is a priority for the ministry,” Ussenov said. According to the ministry, Kazakhstan has previous experience returning its citizens from conflict zones. On October 2, Kazakhstan’s foreign minister met with Russia’s chargé d’affaires in the country. Kazakhstan’s ambassador in Moscow is also expected to meet with officials from the Russian Foreign Ministry and Ministry of Defense. Kazakhstani citizens who recorded the video appeal say that, they originally traveled to Russia for employment and were offered jobs as security guards. They said they were asked to sign documents carrying the name and logo “BARS.” The citizens alleged that the documents were destroyed the following day and replaced with different contracts. When they refused to sign the replacement documents, they said they were told there was “no turning back” and were threatened with imprisonment. The individuals are believed to be in the Luhansk region. According to their account, the men are being sent to the combat zone on a rotational basis. Qaysar Almaz, who appeared in the appeal, and other citizens requested assistance from Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev and the governments of Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan. Separately, data published in April by the Ukrainian project I Want to Live ( Khochu Zhit ) claimed that 12,666 citizens of Central Asian countries were participating in the war on Russia’s side. According to the project’s data, Uzbek citizens represented the largest group, with 4,853 individuals. Tajikistan followed with 3,407, Kazakhstan with 2,389, Kyrgyzstan with 1,439 and Turkmenistan with 578. These figures are attributed to the Ukrainian project and are not independently verified in the information provided. In July, BBC Russian Service and Mediazona reported that at least 3,589 foreign nationals fighting on the Russian side had been killed, including 229 citizens of Uzbekistan. Uzbek legislation provides criminal liability for citizens involved in foreign armed conflicts and military service. Under Article 154 of Uzbekistan’s Criminal Code, being recruited to participate in military hostilities is punishable by up to 10 years in prison. Recruiting, training and deploying individuals for participation in combat operations carries a sentence of up to 12 years. Article 154-1 provides separate liability for Uzbek citizens who enter service in the military, security, police, military justice agencies or similar bodies of foreign states. https://www.gazeta.uz/en/2026/09/29/prot.body: Photo: Legislative Chamber Life imprisonment proposed in Uzbekistan for rape of children under 14 Deputies of Uzbekistan started considering amendments introducing life imprisonment for serious sexual crimes against children. President ordered the changes in February. After a 5-year-old girl was assaulted at a kindergarden this month, calls for strengthening responsibility intensified. O‘zbek tilida Ўзбек тилида На русском языке 29 September 2026, 22:38 Politics Uzbekistan is planning tougher penalties for particularly serious sexual crimes against children, including life imprisonment for raping a child under 14. The relevant draft law was approved by the Legislative Chamber of the Oliy Majlis at its first reading on 29 September . The document was introduced at the initiative of the Adolat (Justice) social-democratic party and is aimed at improving the system for protecting children from all forms of violence. The amendments would be made to the Criminal and Criminal Procedure Codes, the Code of Administrative Responsibility and several other legislative acts. Life imprisonment for crimes against children Between 2022 and 2025, 445 criminal cases were opened in connection with the rape of children under 14, chairwoman of the Committee on Democratic Institutions and Civil Society Development Gulruh Agzamova said. According to her, 85 such cases were opened in 2022, 108 in 2023, 129 in 2024 and 123 in 2025. Advertising on Gazeta The document provides for significantly tougher penalties for particularly serious sexual crimes against minors. In particular, it proposes imposing a long prison term or life imprisonment for the rape of a person under 14 or forcibly satisfying a sexual desire in an unnatural form. In addition, people who commit crimes against the sexual freedom of children would not be able to avoid criminal liability due to the expiration of the statute of limitations. They would also not be eligible for exemption from punishment due to the expiration of the limitation period for enforcing a sentence. The introduction of these amendments was provided for by a presidential decree dated 16 February on implementing the Uzbekistan-2030 Strategy. The decree instructed the authorities to create an effective system for combating violence against women and children and, in particular, to introduce punishment of up to life imprisonment for sexual crimes against children under 14. The decree also provided for the transfer of investigations into sexual and other violent crimes against minors from the police to the prosecutor’s offices and for cases involving violence against children and women to be handled by specially trained investigators and judges. Video recording of child interrogations Another set of amendments concerns the protection of children during investigations and court proceedings. It is proposed that interrogations of minors who have subjected to violence be recorded on video on a mandatory basis. Confrontations between a child who has become a victim of a crime against sexual freedom and a suspect, accused person or defendant would be conducted under a special procedure. If the violence was committed by someone close to the child, a representative of the guardianship and trusteeship authority would have to participate in pretrial proceedings and court hearings. Children who have been subjected to violence or witnessed it would also be provided with legal assistance at the expense of the state, regardless of their family’s financial situation. Liability for inaction The draft law provides for liability not only for people who commit violence but also for those who fail to properly perform their duties to protect children. In particular, it proposes establishing liability for failure to properly care for a child, failure to comply with decisions of commissions dealing with children’s issues or obstruction of their implementation. It is also proposed that the intentional infliction of serious or moderate bodily harm on a minor and committing lewd acts against a child under 16 by a group of people be considered aggravating circumstances. In addition, penalties for involving minors in antisocial behavior are to be increased. Liability of parents and teachers Separate provisions concern the liability of parents and employees of educational institutions. It is proposed to toughen administrative penalties for failure to fulfill parental duties, sexual harassment and violations of legislation on the legal age for marriage. If a teacher commits violence against a child during an educational or upbringing process, this would constitute grounds for termination of the employment contract at the employer’s initiative. The document also proposes liability for violating legal requirements on protecting children from information that may harm their health. The authors of the amendments expect them to strengthen the protection of children’s lives, health, honor and dignity, prevent violence and ensure the restoration of the rights of minors who have suffered abuse. Calls for tougher laws after 5-year-old sexually abused The discussion of tougher legislation comes amid a high-profile case involving sexual violence against a 5-year-old girl attending a state-run kindergarten in Uchkurgan district of Namangan region. A criminal case was opened on 12 September under part 4 of article 118 of the Criminal Code, concerning the rape of a person under 14. A kindergarten employee was remanded in custody. The girl’s mother said the child had become fearful and was afraid to walk past the kindergarten. On 27 September, head of the Presidential Administration Saida Mirziyoyeva stated that not only those responsible but also those who allowed the incident to occur, acted negligently and failed to protect the child should be held accountable. She also said proposals were being prepared to strengthen liability for such crimes to the maximum extent. In early 2025, the Nemolchi.uz project pointed to cases in which sexual crimes against children were classified as administrative offenses, allowing perpetrators to avoid criminal liability. This week, UzLiDeP party deputies, while discussing tougher sanctions, said 44 crimes were reported as administrative offenses during the past three years. Активисты решили озеленить один из участков в Бишкеке (видео) Город Бишкек 739 8 октября 2026 18:00 Kaktus Все самое интересное в Telegram В среду, 7 октября, активисты из Бишкека вместе с ландшафтным дизайнером, мэрией и "Бишкекзеленстроем" начали озеленять участок на пр. Жибек Жолу рядом с Воскресенским собором. Идея появилась после заседания Экологического совета в июле . Тогда горожане жаловались, что высаженные муниципалитетом деревья часто не приживаются и засыхают. Полноценное озеленение Проект разработала ландшафтный дизайнер Катерина Косенко. Он получил название "Жашыл оймо", а его реализацию поддержала мэрия. Для проекта выбрали участок возле остановки "Церковь" рядом с Воскресенским собором. До начала работ он выглядел неухоженно. Участок до / во время проведения работ по благоустройству Утром 7 октября, когда начались работы, организаторы столкнулись с неожиданной проблемой: сотрудники "Бишкекзеленстроя" не знали, как правильно высаживать растения, говорит Катерина Косенко. "Мы им объясняли, показывали. Даже проблема была в том, что мы сказали, что будет капельный полив, а на месте установили форсунки", - рассказала она. По задумке авторов, участок должен быть оформлен в современном авторском стиле с использованием мотивов кыргызского орнамента. 1 из 2 Здесь высадили платаны, барбарис, спирею, кустарники и различные злаковые растения. "Технология - это посадки массивами. Обязательно должны быть деревья, которые устойчивы к загазованности. Еще важно, чтобы было много кустарников. Наша главная задача - защитить город от пыли. И чем больше будет у нас лиственных кустарников, тем быстрее мы защитим город от пыли, и от шума тоже", - рассказала Косенко. По теме: Штрафа мало. Навредивших экологии предлагают заставлять восстанавливать природу Сейчас в Бишкеке высаживается много растений, однако не всегда учитывается их функция, считают активисты. Например, деревья не дают достаточной тени, а кустарники, которые могут задерживать пыль и создавать дополнительный ярус озеленения, нередко убирают с улиц. "Как бы это банально ни звучало, но кустарники - это очень важная биологическая прослойка, которая дает биоразнообразие. Этим проектом мы хотим показать, что можно и нужно озеленять город грамотно, используя не только траву для газонов", - рассказала активистка Александра Фортуна. 1 из 2 Активисты отмечают, что на первом этапе такой подход стоит дороже привычного озеленения, однако в долгосрочной перспективе может оказаться экономичнее. "За однолетниками нужен больший уход. Однолетние растения нужно весной посадить, осенью убрать, почистить, подготовить. В случае же нашего озеленения нужно посадить растения один раз - и мы получаем готовую и красивую композицию на много лет. Кроме того, в дальнейшем можно использовать злаковые для рассады в других местах", - рассказала Косенко. Выживают не все Помимо вырубки деревьев, критику горожан нередко вызывает и то, как в Бишкеке высаживают новые растения. Жители неоднократно обращали внимание на то, что часть саженцев не приживается. По теме: От урана к туризму. Как сегодня Майлуу-Суу хотят открыть для мира по-новому (видео и фото) "Да, многие из недавно высаженных деревьев не приживаются. Во-первых, саженец может быть недостаточно хорош, во-вторых, закрытая корневая система не обеспечивается поливной водой в должном виде. У нас все-таки не север, мы южная страна, воды требуется очень много", - рассказывала редакции активистка Сонун Айдарбаева. При этом мэрия еще в прошлом году определила перечень деревьев, подходящих для высадки в Бишкеке. В него вошли вяз, гледичия, дуб, клен, липа, тополь и другие виды, а также кустарники. Глава столицы Айбек Джунушалиев заявлял о необходимости отказаться от декоративных растений и хвойных деревьев. Однако на практике дела обстояли иначе. В начале года на участке Моссовета от ул. Тыныстанова до ул. Абдрахманова высадили туи. Они не прижились . Позже их заменили другими деревьями, однако часть новых саженцев также погибла . Последнюю высадку на этом участке провели летом, но части деревьев уже нет. Туи на Моссовете. Горожане связывали гибель деревьев в том числе с проблемами полива. При этом озеленение, по мнению экспертов, не должно ограничиваться только посадкой деревьев. Урбанист и эколог Дмитрий Переяславский ранее отмечал , что в Бишкеке сложилась неблагоприятная экосистемная ситуация, в том числе из-за недостатка энтомофагов - полезных насекомых, которые уничтожают вредителей. "Нам нужно везде многоярусное озеленение: и травы, и кустарники, и деревья. Отсутствие какого-либо из ярусов может привести к развитию вредителей, потому что не будет энтомофагов", - рассказывал он. В мэрии, в свою очередь, заявляют, что учитывают предложения горожан и экспертов. Айбек Джунушалиев отмечал, что муниципалитет рассматривает возможность высадки платанов, кленов, лип и других деревьев, которые подходят экосистеме города. По теме: Для бедных стран это роскошь. Бекешев объяснил, почему в КР нет запроса на экоповестку Именно такой подход предлагают использовать и инициаторы проекта "Жашыл оймо". Они надеются, что в будущем мэрия сможет применять их опыт и создавать похожие зеленые пространства по всему городу. "На 42% увеличилось количество респираторных заболеваний. На 10% у детей аллергии увеличились. Мы все кашляем, чихаем. Поэтому нужно на каждом свободном участке земли в городе создавать вот такие пространства и делать город для людей, а не для машин", - сказала активистка Александра Фортуна. мэрия деревья Бишкек высадка деревьев посадка деревьев Есть новость или проблема? https://tass.com/politics/2199217.body: Russia’s Prosecutor General’s Office seeks Netherlands extradition of 9 ICC officials All nine have been placed on an international wanted list © Sergey Bobylev/TASS MOSCOW, October 8. /TASS/. Russia’s Prosecutor General’s Office has sent the Netherlands a request for the extradition of nine representatives of the International Criminal Court (ICC) who were convicted in absentia in Russia, including ICC President Piotr Hofmanski and Prosecutor Karim Khan, the Russian supervisory authority’s press service said. "The Russian Prosecutor General’s Office has sent requests to the Ministry of Justice and Security of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, as well as to a number of other countries, for the detention and extradition of International Criminal Court President P. Y. Hofmanski, ICC First Vice-President C. L. K. Carranza, ICC Prosecutor K. K. A. Khan, and ICC judges T. Akane, R. S. Aitala, S. H. U. Godines, B. Schmitt, R. A. S. Alapini-Gansou and H. B. Mahfoud," the statement said. All nine have been placed on an international wanted list. In December 2025, the Moscow City Court found all nine ICC representatives guilty in absentia of offenses under Part 2 of Article 299 of the Russian Criminal Code (bringing a person known to be innocent to criminal responsibility or unlawfully initiating a criminal case), Part 2 of Article 301 (unlawful detention, arrest or custody), and Part 2 of Article 360 (attacking persons or institutions enjoying international protection, or threatening to do so). They were sentenced to prison terms ranging from three and a half to 15 years. The Prosecutor General’s Office recalled that, citing the political bias of the International Criminal Court, the Russian president issued an order in November 2016 declaring Russia’s intention not to become a party to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court. Notification of this intention was sent to the UN secretary-general. Russia has never been and is not a party to the ICC Rome Statute and does not recognize its jurisdiction. "Despite this, ICC Prosecutor Khan unlawfully brought criminal charges against Russian citizens in The Hague. The ICC Presidency, in the absence of legal grounds, instructed the chamber’s judges to issue manifestly unlawful arrest warrants against them. These decisions were made in violation of fundamental principles and norms of international law and without any evidence that the individuals in question had committed the alleged crimes," the Prosecutor General’s Office said. https://24.kg/article/390838.body: Очередной раунд непрямых переговоров между США и Ираном состоится сегодня, сообщает Axios со ссылкой на источники. Отмечается, что запланированы отдельные встречи посредников из Катара с министром иностранных дел Ирана Аббасом Аракчи и спецпосланником президента США Стивом Уиткоффом. Ранее лидер США Дональд Трамп заявил, что ожидает проведения переговоров с Ираном в течение недели. Катар продолжает выступать посредником между сторонами, говорится в сообщении. «Я ожидаю новых переговоров с Ираном на этой неделе. Они хотят заключить сделку, но предлагают не ту сделку, которая нужна мне», — сказал Дональд Трамп журналистам. Предыдущий раунд непрямых переговоров при участии Катара прошел на прошлой неделе в Нью-Йорке, на полях Генассамблеи ООН. В нем участвовали Аракчи, Уиткофф и Джаред Кушнер. Тегеран предложил в течение недели открыть Ормузский пролив и возобновить переговоры по ядерной программе при условии, что США снимут морскую блокаду, отменят ограничения на продажу иранской нефти и восстановят режим прекращения огня в регионе. Трамп отверг это предложение. Вашингтон настаивает на выполнении своих условий по ядерному вопросу.

https://www.trend.az/azerbaijan/politics.body: Home Azerbaijan Politics Baku Initiative Group issues statement over ongoing protests in France Politics News 8 October 2026 20:10 (UTC +04:00) Photo: AZERTAC Alish Abdulla Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 8. The Baku Initiative Group (BIG) is monitoring with serious concern the ongoing nationwide mobilization of high school students and youth in France, as well as reports regarding severe injuries sustained by protesters, numerous detentions, and the use of dangerous special crowd-control measures. This was reflected in a statement released by the BIG. According to the statement, the movement, which began in the city of Créteil and subsequently spread across France, initially emerged against a backdrop of grievances directly related to the right to quality education, specifically, shortages of teachers and other educational staff, the dilapidated state of school infrastructure, excessive academic workloads, and dissatisfaction with certain aspects of the higher education admissions system. "These grievances later evolved into a nationwide youth movement involving high school and university students, teachers, parents, and trade unions. The scale of these events demands particular attention. As of October 8, the French Minister of the Interior reported that more than 6,600 individuals had been detained, and 215 students and 89 educational staff members had sustained injuries. One particularly concerning aspect involves cases where minors sustain severe injuries. In the city of Lens, a 15-year-old student lost his hand as a result of the explosion of a sound grenade used during the protests. The BIG maintains that the right to education, the freedoms of expression and peaceful assembly, and the protection of children and youth from the use of unnecessary or disproportionate force are universal principles that must be upheld without selective application or double standards. Access to quality education is also a fundamental pillar of the genuine decolonization process. Education enables the elimination of structural inequalities, the preservation of identity, and the establishment of resilient, self-sufficient institutions. The BIG calls upon the French authorities to ensure that law enforcement measures during demonstrations strictly adhere to the principles of necessity, proportionality, and accountability; to guarantee the rights of minors and youth to peacefully express their views and assemble; to ensure effective investigations into incidents resulting in serious injuries; and to engage in substantive dialogue with students, teachers, and their representative organizations. France claims to uphold the protection of human rights, democratic freedoms, and human dignity as fundamental principles of its domestic and foreign policy. The consistent application of these principles must begin at home. Human rights cannot be defended selectively, and young people seeking to make their voices heard should be treated primarily as rights-holders rather than as a security issue. The Baku Initiative Group will continue to closely monitor developments and calls for dialogue, restraint, and full respect for fundamental rights," the statement said. https://english.news.cn/20261008/d65efad.body: Pro-Palestinian protesters rally at U.S. universities to mark 3 years of Gaza war-Xinhua Pro-Palestinian protesters rally at U.S. universities to mark 3 years of Gaza war Source: Xinhua Editor: huaxia 2026-10-08 17:02:30 A pro-Palestine protest is held at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) campus in Los Angeles, California, the United States, Oct. 7, 2026. (Photo by Zeng Hui/Xinhua) LOS ANGELES, Oct. 7 (Xinhua) -- U.S. universities on Wednesday saw pro-Palestinian protesters gather at campus gates for demonstrations marking three years since the war in Gaza began. Dozens of protesters gathered Wednesday at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), chanting slogans including "Stop the genocide" and "Free Palestine." Organized by Students for Justice in Palestine (SJP), the demonstration featured banners reading "Gaza will rise" and placards bearing the message "We will honor all our martyrs." Verbal altercations broke out between some demonstrators and pro-Israel counterprotesters. "We're here protesting to commemorate and honor the resistance of the Palestinian people on Oct. 7," a student protester told Xinhua, saying the anniversary marked "three years of escalated genocide in Palestine." The student, who requested anonymity, said the SJP wanted UCLA to divest, or withdraw investments, from Israeli companies and weapons manufacturers. "That's why we want our university to cut all ties to Israel and stop profiting off of the genocide," the student said, adding that the SJP also demanded an end to campus policing and surveillance, and disclosure of the university's ties with Israel. Outside California, pro-Palestinian protests also erupted in several cities across the United States. In Seattle, dozens of demonstrators marched through the Capitol Hill neighborhood and onto the Seattle Central College campus Wednesday afternoon, reports said. On the East Coast, more than 100 people gathered at Washington Square Park to demand New York University withdraw investments from Israel and shutter its Tel Aviv campus, the New York Post reported. Over 70 pro-Palestinian protesters gathered outside Columbia University's gates the same day, according to the Columbia Daily Spectator. The student newspaper reported that the protest was also organized by the SJP, with participants later joining a citywide demonstration. Hundreds marched near City Hall in New York City's Lower Manhattan, carrying Palestinian flags and chanting "Free Palestine" and "Long Live Palestine," local news outlet amNewYork reported. https://www.trend.az/azerbaijan/4232262..body: Home Azerbaijan UN Human Rights Council adopts mine resolution co-authored by Azerbaijan Azerbaijan News 7 October 2026 18:30 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Artificial intelligence Alamda Nasib Read more BAKU , Azerbaijan , October 7 . The UN Human Rights Council has adopted a resolution titled “Impact of anti-personnel mines on the full enjoyment of human rights: Strengthening victim assistance,” which Azerbaijan co-authored and actively promoted, the Azerbaijani Foreign Ministry said. The resolution was adopted without a vote, with 70 states joining as co-sponsors. During the 63rd session of the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva, Azerbaijan organized a public dialogue to promote and keep the joint initiative on the agenda and co-hosted a side event dedicated to the issue. Azerbaijan, one of the countries most heavily contaminated by mines in the world, faces a severe challenge posed by anti-personnel mines, the ministry said. “Anti-personnel mines and unexploded ordnance have a long-term and severe impact on the full enjoyment of human rights, with serious consequences for the lives of victims and their family members. In this regard, we welcome the particular attention given to victim assistance in the resolution,” the ministry said. The ministry emphasized that mine action is a fundamental element of sustainable peace and plays an important role in post-conflict recovery. “Mine clearance not only enables the safe and dignified return of former internally displaced persons to their homes, but also makes an important contribution to the recovery of conflict-affected areas and communities, as well as ensuring socio-economic development,” it said. The ministry also welcomed the resolution's focus on the interlinkages between mine action, peace and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals. “Mine clearance is also important for ensuring more effective adaptation to climate-related risks. In this regard, we consider it important that the resolution contributes to developing and deepening understanding of the link between mine action and adaptation to climate risks in the context of human rights,” the ministry said. The scale of casualties caused by mines once again demonstrates the need to mobilize stronger international support, partnerships and sustainable financing for mine action and victim assistance, according to the ministry. It welcomed the Human Rights Council's call on member states to increase financing for mine clearance and victim assistance, including through alternative sources of financing and public-private partnerships. “Azerbaijan once again emphasizes the importance of strengthening international cooperation, solidarity and sustained support in addressing the mine threat and highly values the contribution of mine action to the protection of human rights and the promotion of sustainable peace and development,” the ministry said. https://iz.ru/2180675/2026-10-08/ssha-so.body: В США набирает обороты скандал из-за неудачной казни Кристы Пайк. Женщина, осужденная за убийство в 1995 году, смогла выжить после введения двух смертельных доз. Она пришла в сознание и начала разговаривать с адвокатами. Теперь судьям предстоит разобраться, допустима ли попытка повторной казни и при каких обстоятельствах ее можно совершить. Что пишут СМИ об этом — в дайджесте «Известий». Axios: Криста Пайк была «разгневана и растеряна» после пробуждения Представители Кристы Пайк заявили, что после пробуждения в больнице через шесть дней после попытки ее казни в штате Теннесси она была «разгневана и растеряна». Адвокат Рэнди Спиви сообщил журналистам, что команда Пайк первоначально считала, что вечером 5 октября женщина находилась в состоянии «смерти мозга» и что вскоре ее отключат от аппарата жизнеобеспечения. Вместо этого Пайк проснулась и начала говорить, что шокировало ее адвокатов и врачей. Axios 50-летняя Пайк была приговорена к смертной казни за убийство Коллин Слеммер в 1995 году. Она выжила после того, как на прошлой неделе ей ввели две дозы смертельного препарата пентобарбитала. По словам Спиви, [7 октября] Пайк не могла двигать руками или глотать. Он добавил, что у нее была пневмония, тромб в одной руке и сильный отек обеих рук и кистей. По словам Спиви, Пайк осознавала состоявшуюся попытку казни, после того как очнулась. Она спрашивала, где она находится и что произошло, а также задавала вопросы о своей команде адвокатов и семье Слеммера. Однако ее адвокаты признали наличие «когнитивной путаницы». Адвокаты Пайк вновь призвали губернатора Билла Ли заменить ее приговор на пожизненное заключение без права досрочного освобождения. Associated Press: как возможно выжить после двух смертельных инъекций То, что Криста Пайк пришла в себя и заговорила спустя неделю после получения двух доз смертельных препаратов, поразило даже некоторых медицинских работников и заставило многих задуматься: как она выжила? Адвокаты Пайк назвали ее выздоровление «беспрецедентным с медицинской точки зрения», после того как ее подключили к аппарату искусственной вентиляции легких. Они заявили, что Пайк находится в состоянии спутанности сознания, «говорит с трудом» и не может двигать руками, в одной из которых образовался тромб. Associated Press Пайк <...> является единственным человеком, выжившим после введения смертельных препаратов во время казни, согласно данным Центра информации о смертной казни. Многие детали процесса казни остаются засекреченными, и власти штата Теннесси заявляют, что расследуют, что пошло не так. Медицинские эксперты выдвинули несколько возможных объяснений того, как Пайк удалось выжить, включая качество препаратов и возможные проблемы с установкой внутривенной капельницы. Ранее в этом году у палачей в Теннесси возникли проблемы с внутривенными капельницами во время другой казни, что привело к ее отмене. Внутривенный катетер мог быть установлен неправильно или вены Пайк могли лопнуть, в результате чего препарат просочился в окружающие ткани, вместо того чтобы циркулировать в кровотоке. Адвокаты Пайк заявили, что в камере смертников ее кололи иглами как минимум семь раз и что у нее заболевание крови, из-за которого трудно ввести иглу в вену. Инъекции, помилования и 30-летнее ожидание. Что нужно знать о смертной казни в США The Washington Post: судья обязал сохранить доказательства по делу о неудавшейся казни Пайк Судья штата Теннесси распорядился сохранить все доказательства, связанные с неудачной попыткой казни Пайк, которая на прошлой неделе пережила две смертельные дозы пентобарбитала и до сих пор находится в больнице в Нэшвилле. Пайк должна была быть казнена путем смертельной инъекции 30 сентября. Приговор ей был вынесен несколько лет назад за ее участие в пытках и убийстве 19-летней Коллин Слеммер в 1995 году. The Washington Post Слушание [7 октября] в Нэшвилле стало первым судебным заседанием, на котором выступили ее адвокаты после неудачной казни. Они попросили судью И'Эше Майлз в суде округа Дэвидсон обязать департамент исправительных учреждений Теннесси вести журналы учета, хранить записи с камер видеонаблюдения, информацию об оборудовании, медицинские карты и другие сведения, касающиеся событий, произошедших до и после неудачной казни. Майлз также распорядилась, чтобы государство вернуло любую информацию или материалы, которые могли быть уже выброшены. Адвокат, представлявший штат, заявил в суде, что сотрудники тюрьмы уже начали сохранять доказательства в соответствии с требованиями отдельного дела в федеральном суде, касающегося протоколов исполнения смертных приговоров. Associated Press: попытка снова казнить Пайк приведет на неизведанную юридическую территорию После того как Пайк пережила неудачную попытку казни, нерешенный вопрос о том, будет ли штат предпринимать еще одну попытку, может ввергнуть Теннесси в неизведанную правовую ситуацию. Хотя в других штатах предпринимались попытки повторной казни заключенных, в этих случаях первая попытка была пресечена еще до начала введения препаратов. Уходящий в отставку губернатор-республиканец Билл Ли приостановил казни в Теннесси и распорядился провести независимую проверку неудачной казни. Associated Press «Вопрос о том, будет ли законной попытка штата Теннесси снова казнить ее, сложен и потребует значительного времени, внимания и анализа со стороны ее команды защиты, команды обвинения, правительства штата Теннесси и многочисленных судов штата и федеральных судов», — сказал Стивен Джонсон, адвокат по уголовным делам из Теннесси, избранный президент Национальной ассоциации адвокатов по уголовным делам. В прошлом были зафиксированы десятки случаев казней, вызвавших проблемы, в том числе несколько попыток, которые не закончились смертью. В 1946 году палачи в Луизиане пытались казнить 17-летнего Уилли Фрэнсиса, но прекратили попытку после того, как неправильно подготовленный электрический стул не смог его убить. Он был все-таки казнен после того, как Верховный суд США постановил, что вторая попытка казни не нарушает принцип недопустимости двойного наказания и не является жестоким и необычным наказанием. Смертный приговор: в Израиле приняли закон о казни для террористов Крайняя мера направлена против палестинцев The Guardian: в Техасе казнили первого мужчину после неудачной попытки смертельной инъекции Пайк В Техасе был казнен мужчина, что стало первой казнью в США после неудачной смертельной инъекции, которой была подвергнута Криста Пайк в Теннесси на прошлой неделе. 46-летний Джамал Ховард был объявлен мертвым в 20:03 после получения смертельной дозы пентобарбитала в тюрьме штата в Хантсвилле. The Guardian Адвокаты Говарда пытались остановить казнь, утверждая в техасском апелляционном суде по уголовным делам, что существуют аналогичные риски при казни Говарда с использованием того же смертельного инъекционного препарата, который был использован для Пайк. Пайк пережила две дозы пентобарбитала и жаловалась, что у нее было ощущение, будто ее руки вот-вот взорвутся во время введения препарата. Суд отклонил ходатайство о приостановлении исполнения приговора, а позже отклонил и вторую попытку остановить казнь из-за наркотиков. Суд отклонил оба ходатайства без объяснений. Верховный суд США также отклонил поданную апелляцию без комментариев. В Техасе в этом году уже казнили шесть человек, и после казни Ховарда запланированы еще две смертельные инъекции. https://www.trend.az/azerbaijan/society/.body: Home Azerbaijan Society Azerbaijan NGO opens landmine exhibition in Czech Republic (PHOTO) Society News 8 October 2026 16:58 (UTC +04:00) Alish Abdulla Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 8. Azerbaijan’s Gilavar Photo Club Public Union held an exhibition highlighting the country’s landmine problem in Brno, the Czech Republic’s second-largest city, on October 7, 2026, as part of its ongoing international campaign to promote the declaration of a “mine-free world” as the 18th UN Sustainable Development Goal. The exhibition on Armenia’s mine warfare against Azerbaijan was organized in partnership with the Land of Fire Azerbaijani diaspora organization in the Czech Republic, according to the State Support Agency for Non-Governmental Organizations of Azerbaijan. The exhibition featured documentary photographs depicting the life stories of Azerbaijanis affected by landmines and the severe consequences of mine explosions. Visitors were informed that extensive mine contamination of Azerbaijani territories during the occupation and the failure to provide accurate mine maps remain among the major obstacles to the safe return of Azerbaijanis to their native lands. It was also noted that Armenia should demonstrate humanitarian responsibility and provide accurate mine maps as a practical expression of its commitment to peace and a means of strengthening mutual trust. The Brno exhibition also highlighted the connection between the landmine problem and the issue of missing persons, noting that civilians are the primary victims in both cases. According to information presented at the exhibition, 32 mass graves have so far been discovered in the liberated territories. Examinations of human remains, it was reported, confirmed that the Azerbaijanis whose remains were found had been subjected to torture before being killed. The Gilavar Photo Club is a 2026 winner of the “Initiatives on the Problem of Mines and Unexploded Ordnance” grant competition, jointly announced by Azerbaijan’s NGO Agency and the Karabakh Revival Fund in partnership with the Azerbaijan National Agency for Mine Action (ANAMA). https://www.gazeta.uz/en/2026/10/03/law-.body: Photo: Senate of Uzbekistan Senate approves life imprisonment for raping children under 14 Uzbekistan’s Senate approved a law strengthening protection of children from all forms of violence. It provides for life imprisonment for raping children under 14, video-recorded interrogations, restrictions on working with children for those held accountable for violence and other measures. Ўзбек тилида O‘zbek tilida На русском языке 3 October 2026, 22:30 Politics The Senate of the Oliy Majlis of Uzbekistan approved a law on 2 October that strengthens liability for all forms of violence against children and expands their protection during investigations and court proceedings. For the law to enter into force, it must be signed by the president. The amendments provide for stricter penalties for certain sexual offenses against children, additional procedural safeguards for minor victims and witnesses and restrictions on people held accountable for violence against children. The law continues reforms envisaged by the Strategy for Protecting Children from All Forms of Violence for 2026−2030. Up to 25 years or life imprisonment One of the key changes concerns punishment for particularly serious sexual offenses against children under 14. Rape of a child under 14, as well as the forcible satisfaction of sexual needs in an unnatural form involving such a child, will be punishable by up to 25 years in prison or life imprisonment (the current penalty is 15 to 20 years in prison). In addition, statutes of limitations for criminal prosecution and enforcement of a conviction will not apply to particularly serious crimes against the sexual integrity of children. Advertising on Gazeta For intentional crimes resulting in the death of a child, suspended sentences and parole will be prohibited. What the statistics show At the Senate meeting, chairman of the Committee on Judicial and Legal Issues and Anti-Corruption Abdulhakim Eshmuratov cited data on crimes against children. Under part 4 of article 118 of the Criminal Code (rape of a person under 14), 85 criminal cases were initiated in 2022, 108 in 2023, 129 in 2024 and 123 in 2025. Under part 4 of article 119 of the Criminal Code (forcible satisfaction of sexual needs in an unnatural form involving a person under 14), 144 criminal cases were registered in 2022, 163 in 2023, 170 in 2024 and 116 in 2025. The number of reports concerning sexual harassment of minors increased from 56 in 2023 to 141 in 2025. During the discussion, recent high-profile cases were mentioned as examples demonstrating the need to strengthen protection of children from sexual violence. Free lawyer and video-recorded interrogations The amendments expand procedural safeguards for minors who have been subjected to violence or witnessed it. They will be provided with free legal assistance at the expense of the state from the moment they are first involved in procedural actions. Interrogations of minors who have been subjected to violence must be video-recorded. A special procedure will be established for confrontations between a child who has been a victim of a crime against sexual freedom and a suspect, accused person or defendant. Such a confrontation will be conducted only on the basis of a decision by an investigator, prosecutor or a court ruling. If the violence was committed by a family member or close relative, the participation of a representative of the guardianship and trusteeship authority in procedural actions will become mandatory. Educational institution employees may be dismissed for violence Amendments to the Labor Code provide for the possibility of terminating an employment contract at the employer’s initiative with an employee of an educational organization if they have been held accountable for violence against a child. Such individuals will also be subject to restrictions on further work with children. Parents' liability to be increased and other amendments The law provides for increased administrative liability for improper performance of duties toward children. This includes a lack of proper care, deliberate failure to meet a child’s basic needs, violations of legislation on the legal age for marriage, as well as failure to take measures to protect children from information that could harm their health. Other amendments are aimed at protecting the confidentiality of women and children who have been subjected to harassment or violence. At their request, government bodies will be able not to send written or electronic responses to their place of residence. As noted at the meeting, the measure is intended to reduce the risk of repeated violence and escalation of family conflicts. The amendments also provide for liability for improper performance of childcare duties, failure to comply with decisions of commissions on children’s affairs or obstruction of their implementation. Children will no longer be placed in special educational institutions The law abolishes the compulsory measure of placing minors in special educational institutions. Instead, alternative measures will be used, including referral to an educational, child-upbringing or social organization, placing the minor under supervision with a warning and other forms of intervention. In addition, intentional infliction of serious or moderate bodily harm on a minor will be considered an aggravating circumstance. Liability will also be increased for involving minors in antisocial behavior and for indecent acts against a child under 16 committed by a group of people. The discussion of tougher legislation comes amid a high-profile case involving sexual violence against a 5-year-old girl attending a state-run kindergarten in Uchkurgan district of Namangan region. A criminal case was opened on 12 September under part 4 of article 118 of the Criminal Code, concerning the rape of a person under 14. A kindergarten employee was remanded in custody. On 27 September, head of the Presidential Administration Saida Mirziyoyeva stated that not only those responsible but also those who allowed the incident to occur, acted negligently and failed to protect the child should be held accountable. She also said proposals were being prepared to strengthen liability for such crimes to the maximum extent. https://thediplomat.com/2026/09/kyrgyz-p.body: Credit: Depositphotos Subscribe for ads-free reading Last week, Kyrgyzstan’s parliament, the Zhogorku Kenesh, officially set a date for the next presidential election: January 27, 2027. The country’s Central Election Commission (CEC) then opened the door for formal nominations . So far, incumbent President Sadyr Japarov and Omurbek Suvanaliev – a politician and former minister of internal affairs – have announced their intentions to run. In August, Japarov announced that he would seek a second term , something his political surrogates have been floating for some time . Japarov was elected, formally, in January 2021 after rising from literal prison to power amid the October 2020 unrest. At the time, Kyrgyzstan’s constitution mandated a single six-year presidential term. A referendum that took place at the same time as the presidential election in 2021 ushered in what critics called the “ Khanstitution , ” which provides for two five-year terms for the presidency. In February 2026 , Kyrgyzstan’s Constitutional Court clarified that Japarov’s current term does count as his first. Japarov confirmed his ambition to seek a second term in an interview in which he also revealed that he’d initially planned for his former ally and former head of Kyrgyzstan’s State Committee for National Security, Kamchybek Tashiev, to ascend to the presidency. Japarov claimed he’d told Tashiev, “Be prepared, cleanse your circle, educate your people... Then I see: he’s not ready.” Tashiev was convicted of a coup attempt in July , but spared a prison sentence. Prosecutors sought a harsher punishment on appeal only to have the charges reclassified and the sentence lessened further in September. He long denied any ambition to run for president. A month before his abrupt February dismissal , Tashiev responded to mounting rumors that he would seek the presidency by saying, “Many have tried and continue to try to sow discord between us, claiming that I aspire to the presidency. But this is not true... I do not intend to overthrow Sadyr Nurgoyevich [Japarov]... In this life, only death can separate us.” Under the Kyrgyz Constitution, any citizen who is at least 35 years old, speaks the state language (Kyrgyz), and has lived in the country for at least 15 years is eligible to run for president. Potential candidates must gather at least 30,000 signatures and pay a nonrefundable fee of 1 million som (around $11,400). Individuals can nominate themselves or be nominated by a party. Under 2025 legislation , individuals with criminal records are barred from running for president. Suvanaliev announced his presidential ambition in a September 24 interview with RFE/RL’s Kyrgyz Service, Azattyk . Suvanaliev served as minister of internal affairs from 2006-2007 under the Kurmanbek Bakiyev administration, then as governor of Naryn from 2008-2009, among other positions over the years, many of which appear to have been related to security and law enforcement. More recently, in 2019 then-President Sooronbay Jeenbekov appointed Suvanaliev a deputy secretary in the Security Council, a position he was dismissed from in October 2020 as the Jeenbekov administration collapsed in the face of protests. Until May 2021 , he was serving as a representative of the government in Batken region . In 2011, Suvanaliev contested for the presidency as an independent candidate. He recorded just over 16,000 votes, or 0.89 percent, in an election that Almazbek Atambayev won with 63.83 percent. According to Azattyk , Suvanaliev positioned himself as opposition. He said he believes that a candidate who can challenge the incumbent president should run in the elections. Japarov said in his August interview that the door was open for anyone to run against him: “Anyone who wants to run for office can do so. As they say, go ahead. We won’t restrict anyone. The elections will be transparent, and there will be no obstacles for competitors.” In the country’s most recent election, a snap parliamentary poll held in November 2025, Japarov’s allies did particularly well amid a political atmosphere that observers referred to as “stifled” or dead . As the presidential election approaches – and candidates step forward – the proof will be on the ballot and in the aftermath. Already have an account? Log in . https://en.kabar.kg/news/mongolia-signs-.body: Bishkek, Oct. 2, 2026. /Kabar/. Mongolia has signed loan agreements with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for projects supporting the development of the country’s education and health sectors, Montsame reported. Under the Second Additional Financing for the Sustaining Access to and Quality of Education During Economic Difficulties Project, nine new schools and five kindergartens will be constructed, 17 schools and one kindergarten will be expanded, and the construction of one school will be completed. These measures will increase the capacity of schools and kindergartens by 11,140 places. Meanwhile, the USD 225 million Provincial Health Service Strengthening and Modernization Project will strengthen the capacity of health organizations in 19 aimags and gradually modernize aimag hospital infrastructure, emergency care, intensive care and surgical services. The project will also modernize health centers in 11 remote soums and soums located along border crossings, improve the provision of necessary medical equipment and vehicles, and construct a new 300-bed model provincial hospital in Uvurkhangai aimag. The two projects are being implemented under the General Financing Program agreed between Mongolia and the ADB in 2025. During the signing of the agreements, Minister of Finance Mendsaikhan Zagdjav noted that cooperation between Mongolia and the ADB has successfully expanded over the past 35 years. He expressed appreciation to the ADB for making major investments and supporting the development of Mongolia’s education and health sectors, and expressed confidence that bilateral relations and cooperation would continue to strengthen.
